messages.author: 80755bfe7e9738f7
messages.subject: Problem to see shinny apps
parts:
Hi all.

We have a problem with shinny apps.

I see the main page of shinny server, but i show all my seens.

shiny-server restart
[2017-02-06 18:28:54.589] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v1.5.1.834 (Node.js v6.9.1)
[2017-02-06 18:28:54.596] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/opt/shiny-server/restart"
[2017-02-06 18:28:54.624] [ERROR] shiny-server - Error loading config: File "/opt/shiny-server/restart" does not exist
[2017-02-06 18:28:54.626] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes


.conf file

run_as shiny;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /opt/shiny-server/samples/sample-apps;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;
  }



}



another more file log init app.

messages.subject: Re: Problem to see shinny apps
parts:
I am also receiving this exact error when attempting to use the run_as command to run apps as a user other than the 'shiny' user. The sample apps, on the other hand, are working just fine. Here's my attempted config:

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"

run_as shiny;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory

# Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;
  }

# Run a specific app (shiny_test_app) as a specific user (cloud)
  location /shiny_test_app {
    run_as test_user;
    site_dir /home/test_user/projects/shiny_test_app;
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;
    directory_index on;

}

}
